implemented: table conditional-formatting look maps to w:tblLook: \tbllkhdrrows -> first_row, \tbllkhdrcols -> first_column, \tbllklastrow -> last_row, \tbllklastcol -> last_column, \tbllknocolband -> no_v_band (\tbllknorowband -> no_h_band), applied at table creation from the first row and rendered by the table-style conditional pass.
table direction maps to w:bidiVisual: \rtlrow sets it, \ltrrow clears it.

the character-grid / table-growth / conditional band compat controls (\cgrid, \snaptogridincell, \nocxsptable, \nogrowautofit, \usenormstyforlist, \irow, \irowband, \lastrow) are Info (no WML equivalent), and the row/cell grid mapping, horizontal merge (\clmgf/\clmrg), vertical merge (\clvmgf/\clvmrg), vertical align, cell widths and the row grid were already mapped.
remaining: borders/shading are entirely unmapped. Paragraph borders (\brdrt/\brdrb/\brdrl/\brdrr/\brdrbar/\brdrbtw), cell borders (\clbrdr{t,b,l,r}), table borders (\brdrtbl), row borders (\trbrdr*), page borders (\pgbrdr*) and the per-edge \brdrs/\brdrth/\brdrdb/\brdrdot/\brdrdash/\brdrw/\brdrcf/\brsp style tokens are all Loss (~35k events). The RTF grammar is `<edge> <style> \brdrw? \brsp? \brdrcf?`; the four standard edges map cleanly to Borders, but \brdrbar/\brdrbtw need w:pBdr between/bar, which the shared Borders model does not carry yet.
cell shading (\chshdng/\clshdrawnil), diagonal cell borders (\cldgll/\cldglu) and the nested-table structure (currently explicitly Reject) remain unreviewed.

table indent \tblind / \tblindtype: the indent is already represented by the row position (\trleft), and WPS writes no w:tblInd for the corpus; the type has no Strict form. Left as Loss pending a witness that needs it.
